BTC, ETH, and SOL have modest long composites but adverse alpha, while ETH/SOL carry high beta and volatility. LTC and XRP are already flat with negative composites. DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile because zero volatility, expected shortfall, liquidity, and institutional-factor fields make their apparent long signals unusable for risk sizing. No counsellor opinions were provided for corroboration.
